Name: Prairie King Firearms
Author: MrHatmann
Description:
A weapon pack for PeacefulEnd's lovely Archery mod that adds weapons based on the guns from the Journey of the Prairie King Mini-Game.

I will start by saying this mod is in a [b][i]BETA [/i][/b]state currently as I made this in like 5 hours after I saw the Archery mod in trending. I have always wanted to add some types of firearms to the game, especially after the constant mentions of war in the background, but I also didn't want to go straight for making things too heavy for the peaceful Stardew Valley countryside. Thank you once again PeacefulEnd, I referenced your sample packs heavily to make this.

This weapon pack adds:
- 4 pistol variants based on the upgrades from Journey of the Prairie King. (Some are a bit scuffed for now. They all use the Crossbow type)
- 5 ammo types (3 based on ones from the game, 2 custom)

Future Plans:
- Make bullets exclusive to the guns, and make guns unable to use bolts.
- More gun types beyond the ones from the minigame or loosely based on them. (Minigun?  Shotgun? Somehow?)
- More interesting bullet types?
- Expansion.

Check out the source mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16767]Archery[/url]

[b][u]Weapons[/u][/b]
[i]Pistols need to be reloaded like crossbows and can store more bullets between reloads with each tier.[/i]

Peashooter: A pistol that is based on the starting weapon. (1200g)
5-10 Damage, can only chamber 1 bullet.

Cobra: The next upgrade. (10000g)
10-15 Damage, can chamber 3 bullets.

Six Shot: The big one. (25000g)
15-20 Damage, can chamber 6 bullets.

Kingmaker: The weapon of a winner. (50000g)
25-40 Damage, can chamber 8 bullets.

[u][b]Ammo
[/b][/u][i]Ammo for the guns. [/i]

Plastic Bullet: (10g)
+1 damage.

Lead Bullet: (100g)
+10 damage.

Aluminium Bullet: (200g)
+20 damage.

Frag Bullet: (300g)
+20 damage, explodes when it hits enemies.

Steel Bullet: (350g)
+35 damage.

Iridium Bullet: (500g)
+50 damage.


[b][u]Known Issues
[/u][/b]Seems to be some issues with how[b] Fashion Sense [/b]hides textures; not using any hats or accessories can occasionally hide the gun textures.


[b]Special Thanks once again to PeacefulEnd.[/b]
